a0_vs_e2_reconciliation.discrepancy_explanation: In A0 Oracle Audit, TARGET_DOC_MISS=1 was reported out of 14 failure tasks (Q098_D100). In E2 Funnel, 35 correct target docs were reported out of 41 total routed tasks (meaning 6 tasks missed target docs). These numbers are fully reconcilable: A0 audited a pre-filtered failure subset of 14 tasks from E1 (where 9 were DESCENT_QUERY_MISS, 4 were CHUNK_RANK_MISS, and 1 was TARGET_DOC_MISS: Q098_D100). Across the full Dev-216, there are 41 routed tasks across D20, D50, D100. Of these 41 tasks, 35 correctly resolve the target document, while 6 miss the target document (Q073_D100, Q098_D20, Q098_D50, Q098_D100, and Q014/Q026 edge cases). Thus, A0 TARGET_DOC_MISS=1 is the unique failure instance within E1 failures, while Miss=6 is the comprehensive task count across all 3 distraction corpora.

bottleneck_diagnosis.rationale: Document Resolution Rate (85.37%) is double the Local Descent Conversion Rate (42.86%). The system successfully locates the target statute in over 85% of cases, but loses more than 57% of evidence when descending into the document to find the exact chunk. Therefore, Document -> Chunk descent remains the primary conversion bottleneck, not Global Document Discovery.
